capabilities: Record microphone audio into the daily log or at the cursor
Record meetings by mixing system audio with the microphone
Transcribe recordings on-device, via an OpenAI-style service, or by hand-off to an external program
Run an AI agent over transcripts to summarize or tidy them, and name speakers
Remove recordings and auto-delete audio after a keep time
disambiguation: Not a recorder of vault or screen activity; it records microphone and system audio into notes.
extras: main.js is about 9.5 MB because the on-device speech engine is bundled, which trips Obsidian Sync Standard's 5 MB file limit (install the plugin separately on each device). Uses an undocumented Obsidian API for Daily Notes settings. Closing Obsidian mid-recording loses that recording by design; the meeting mode has a known audio-device bug on Windows.
problem: Obsidian's built-in audio recorder only records the microphone and embeds a file; it cannot capture the other side of a call, place recordings under a chosen heading, transcribe them, or act on the transcript.

relations.evidence: reads the daily-log folder and filename pattern from the core Daily Notes plugin's configuration
One model that has done the daily-log job well is Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5

requires.name: e.g. OpenAI, Groq, Together AI, Mistral, Anthropic
External program for hand-off transcriber or agent

summary: Audio recorder that captures microphone or meeting (system audio) into the daily log or notes, with optional on-device or service transcription and AI agents.
